translations.web: Arise therefore, and go to your house. When your feet enter into the city, the child will die.
translations.bsb: As for you, get up and go home. When your feet enter the city, the child will die.
translations.kjv: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house: and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.
translations.asv: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thy house: and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.
